elements_selected.content: TOFU branch of the shim: acquire navigator.locks exclusive lock → unregister all ServiceWorkers → generate 32-byte random challenge → invoke navigator.credentials.create() with PRF extension and per-cohort salt → derive K_wrap via HKDF → AES-256-GCM wrap priv_A with origin+cohort_id AAD → store in IndexedDB → replaceState → rewrite hrefs. Per-cohort PRF salt per REQ-3414 + ADR-3414 (BUG-003 resolution). Explicit random challenge per CON-3409 (BUG-005 resolution). Concurrency serialisation via navigator.locks (BUG-010).
